note: Live check ingest.perpetual_cycle: the host in ingest mode (operating.host), every connected source's capture CLI as one host cycle, budgets sized so two cycles fit the daily timeout (worst case about 3300 s a cycle). Paths are relative to this file. Portal reads through the host's mirror audience; mail and SharePoint capture under the host's capture audience (svc:workbench-host, as host.all_sources), so the host's trim and SharePoint census read what was captured; Teams and SharePoint lists keep the audiences of their own live checks. BC is held to purchaseReceipts, a set without calculated fields: cycle 2 reads its headers from the modified-since watermark, while purchaseReceiptLines is read in full every pass by design (Undo Receipt edits a posted receipt) and counts as full by design, not as a resume.
